            remaining_marks.append(max_remaining)
            current_sum += max_remaining
    
    # Recalculate the median after assigning the remaining marks
    all_marks = marks + remaining_marks
    all_marks.sort()
    median_index = (n // 2)
    new_median = all_marks[median_index]
    
    # Check if the new median is less than y
    if new_median < y:
        print(-1)
        return
    
    # Output the result
    print(" ".join(map(str, remaining_marks)))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
